[GLOBAL] Global Autos: April Global Auto Sales: slow (27 May 2026) Global market +0.7% in April. Still falling in the US and in China, compensated with Europe, EMs strong growth and back to positive in Japan. Premium market now losing YoY share globally vs mass market sales.

[EUROPE] Ferrari NV: A different kind of Ferrari (26 May 2026) The first ever BEV Ferrari is positioned at the upper end of the current "range" line-up, and introduces a new design language that has generated mixed reactions so far. Initial feedback from both the press and investors has skewed negative, which is reflected in the share price performance (c.-8% at the time of writing).

[EUROPE] Stellantis: CMD: ambitious targets, focus moves to execution (21 May 2026) Clear turnaround messages, addressing key issues: product, brands, cost, capacity utilization, investments and margin, including additional partnerships. Targets look ambitious to us, the market is not going to help, the focus now moves to execution and delivery.

[KOREA] Hankook Tire & Technology Co Ltd: Research Tactical Idea (27 May 2026) We believe the share price will rise in absolute terms over the next 15 days. Other...Despite the market's initial fear of input cost headwinds weighing on HT's 2H26 profitability outlook, we expect upcoming tire price hikes to offset rising input cost pressure and allow the company to sustain healthy tire margins.

[KOREA] Hankook Tire & Technology Co Ltd: Looming Price Hikes (27 May 2026) Despite the market's initial fear of input cost headwinds weighing on HT's 2H26 profitability outlook, we expect it to announce a series of price hikes to offset rising input cost pressure and sustain healthy tire margins. At 5.6x 2026e P/E, we continue to see an attractive risk/reward profile.

[INDIA] Ashok Leyland Ltd.: In-line Quarter, Inflationary Headwinds Keep Us EW (28 May 2026) EBITDA was \(4\%\) ahead of our estimate, margin at \(14.6\%\), down 40bps YoY. Demand is holding up well but headwinds need to be monitored. To manage commodity headwinds, the company has hiked prices 1-1.5%. Commodity headwind is a challenge but AL did not quantify it. Switch mobility has turned profitable. The company is starting battery pack manufacturing also.

[INDIA] Amara Raja Batteries Ltd.: Key Takeaways from the Conference Call (26 May 2026) New energy business: Its customer qualification plant is expected to see full-scale operations by F2Q27 while the phase 1 (2GWh NMC) line is expected to commence by 2Q CY27. Per management, all major equipment for the first 2 GWh cell line has been ordered.

[CHINA] Li Auto Inc.: 1Q26 call takeaways – 1Q a trough quarter; targeting 40%+ YoY volume growth in 2H (28 May 2026) Management targets 2Q26 group GpM of 10%+ and vehicle margin of ~10%: With more material cost inflation reflected in 2Q and a higher proportion of i6, ultimately, vehicle margin will hinge on L9 deliveries.

[CHINA] XPeng Inc.: 1Q26 Call Takeaways – Growth to build through year-end (28 May 2026) Sales volume to grow sequentially through year-end: GX is expected to support a meaningful pickup in sales volume starting in June. Beyond GX, Xpeng plans to launch three additional SUV models (L03, L05 and one more) which should support sequential sales growth in each quarter through the remainder of the year.

[CHINA] Minth Group Limited: Asia AI Summit 2026 Feedback – Stepping into AI Opportunities (28 May 2026) Minth joined our Summit together with its subsidiary United Alloy Tech (UAT, 3162.TWO). Investor focus was mainly on AIDC business potential, in particular recent initiatives such as SOFC (solid oxide fuel cell) and SST (solid state transformer).

(27 May 2026) BYD's overseas registrations fell 10-15% MoM in April as UK sales normalized from the March peak (5k vs. 15k in March)...Offsetting growth in LatAm (~2.5k MoM) and SEA (~1k MoM). YoY growth still reached 55-60% in April. Geely's overseas registration increased 10-15% MoM, driven by ~2.5k sales growth in Brazil and ~1k in Australia. YoY growth reached 95-100% in April.
